goals.goal: The manufacturer draws up and maintains a software bill of materials (SBOM) covering the components and dependencies in the product with digital elements, in a commonly used and machine-readable format including at minimum the top-level dependencies; the SBOM is retained in the technical documentation through the support period and the 10-year retention tail; on a reasoned request from a market surveillance authority, the SBOM is provided where necessary for the authority to check compliance with the Annex I cybersecurity requirements.
goals.source: Annex I Part II (1); Annex VII §2(b); Annex VII §8; Art. 3(39)
goals.adjustment: Restated from the corpus baseline for TinyTask's 8-employee B2B SaaS scale — the three-anchored SBOM architecture (authoring, retention, MSA disclosure) is discharged with a documented technical-documentation artefact bundle and an MSA-request log; the optional Annex II §9 user-facing access is at manufacturer's discretion and not enabled by default for B2B products; GDPR confirmed in pack but carries no SBOM obligation in this sub-domain (CRA sole authority per AEGIS taxonomy §4.1).
